text: Ethics in AI is an important topic today. As artificial intelligence becomes part of our daily lives, we must think about how it affects people. One major concern is bias, because AI systems can learn unfair patterns from data and treat some groups badly. To prevent this, we need fairness in the way these systems are designed and used. Privacy is another key issue, since AI often collects and uses personal information. Companies should also be transparent, so people understand how decisions are made. Finally, responsible AI development means building technology that respects human values and helps society. Everyone involved, from developers to governments, has a role to play.
